largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.gap: Six forward toes read as broad fairly planar overlapping dorsal covers, merging into a plate-covered platform. Source toes show fuller convex metal segments, narrowed joints and shaped side returns continuous with the ankle mechanism.
largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.evidence: LockedSept22 foreground feet and Maker feet show convex proximal sections and small dark separations. Mechanic/Advanced corroborate inherited foot character, but their smaller/occluded foot regions do not specify hidden sections.
largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.proposal: Three dominant curved U-section shells per forward digit, separated by two pinched recessed joints with shallow side shoulders. Keep inherited dark tendon recessed beneath them. Unequal longitudinal crowns and narrow formed returns replace planar roofs or continuous tubes. Fit the retained instep/saddle connection; keep toe directions and footprint.
largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.scope_limiter: No bolts/scratches/hoses or width/length increase. Retain current ankle hubs, cuffs, saddle, instep and rear digits initially.

largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.gap: Forward CGF03 talons have swollen smooth teardrop roots and a broad cone-like bulge. Source claws read as narrower rooted, dorsally shaped descending hooks ending in sharp ground-pointed tips.
largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.evidence: LockedSept22 foreground claw silhouettes and Maker claws. Far/inner faces remain uncertain.
largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.proposal: Six forward claw successors with narrower oval/triangular roots, a subtle dorsal ridge, continuous arched descent and precise pointed tips. Fit between current receiving cuff/root and current visible CGF03 endpoint, preserving contacts. Reuse exact era forged-steel graph.
largest_two_source_visible_form_correcti.scope_limiter: No extension, altered floor height, shifted root/contact points, saw-teeth or organic nails. Rear claws remain a documented inherited limit.

bounded_successor_strategy.first_design: One coherent six-forward-digit/six-claw design, common geometry across all3 eras. At most48 new meshes:18 shells,12 joint returns,6 seats,6 claws,up to6 necessary transitions. Prefer fewer. No single-toe proxy promoted as whole-character gain.
bounded_successor_strategy.checkpoint: Matched whole-bird before/candidate clay and PBR within15-30minutes of later implementation. Fixed camera/light/exposure. Feet/front/side/rear evidence only if whole evidence shows gain.
bounded_successor_strategy.materials: Resolve exact role graphs from actual receiving object bindings listed here. Reuse era graphs, no original edits, no map renaming or image copying.
bounded_successor_strategy.stop: Stop first design if whole-image gain is absent or stance/footprint regression appears. A subsequent approach needs architect direction within loop controls; this brief authorizes no iterations.
bounded_successor_strategy.delivery: New versioned module/native only after explicit assignment. Save/reopen; compare original payloads, graphs/maps and permitted visibility deltas; retain rollback.

fixed_views: Actual retained source/canon camera in neutral and exhibit lighting, identical before/candidate settings.
Whole side and rear/grazing views for toe height, plantar silhouette, rear claw overlap and ankle continuity.
Exact09 feet-detail is diagnostic only; retained-baseline cameras govern later evidence.
whole_image_gain_regression_test.gain: At normal whole-bird display size feet read as separate articulated metal digits with hooked pointed claws, smaller smooth root bulbs and coherent ankle-to-toe descent. Close-up-only gain, counts, named-point proxies and material presets are insufficient.
reject_if: Wider/longer footprint, changed toe splay, raised/floating tips, or altered hip/knee/hock/ankle anchors.
Shoe-like platform, continuous tube, flat sheet ladder or ring-stack noise.
Toe gaps collapse or become large accidental voids; distracting spikes/intersections/Z-fighting.
Added foot bulk dominates full bird or weakens flightless avian identity.
Rear continuity regresses or ankle linkage is obscured.
Any original graph/map/payload or frozen historical resource mismatch.
whole_image_gain_regression_test.acceptance: Independent QC/architect retention remain separate from owner artistic likeness acceptance.

estimated_depth_limits.toe: Use current tendon section centerlines and cover bounds. Dorsal convexity increase at most0.010m; outer shoulder width reduction about10-15% if useful to digit separation. Do not widen/lengthen; stay below existing ankle exterior envelope.
estimated_depth_limits.joint: Two unequal6-9mm longitudinal pinched seams; adjust visible depth for metal continuity, not broad voids. Source pixels do not define gap depth.
estimated_depth_limits.claw: Approx15-25% reduction of swollen root section; current root/contact endpoints stay exact. Dorsal ridge at most3mm. Hidden/far sections inferred.
estimated_depth_limits.contacts: Derive contacts from current visible CGF03 talon tip geometry and inherited plantar clearance, not hidden CG1c tip extended again. All26 named hinge/plantar/tendon/talon source anchor payloads protected.
